releases.notes: First public release: SRT decoding to Blackmagic, NDI, displays and multiview; 7-day trial and licensing; feedback and crash reporting; automatic updates; guided tour.

Release notes now show in the update window. The app keeps one signing identity across updates, so macOS stops asking for your password to read the license (you may be asked one last time after this update; choose Always Allow).

Stops the repeated Keychain password prompts: the app is now signed so macOS recognises every update as the same app (you may be asked one last time after this update). After installing an update, the app reopens the copy that was just updated.

New sources: RTMP/RTMPS (listen or pull), RTSP, HLS and NDI, plus SRT Caller with stream ID. Stream Health window (Shift-Cmd-H) with bitrate, frame rate, SRT link stats and dropped frames. Keeps the Mac awake while streaming, resumes streams after a restart, optional Open at Login. Up to 8 streams on Pro/Max/Ultra Macs. Asks before removing a stream.

Recording: one Record button records every stream with Record Enable on, in sync, as Original (no re-encode), H.264, H.265, ProRes Proxy or ProRes LT, with time-of-day timecode. Restarted streams continue the take. The multiview records its clean picture. Audio is now always on; choose None (Multiview Only) to keep a stream off the Mac's speakers.
Updated guided tour: Record Enable, the Record button and Stream Health. Help menu text for Resume Streams at Launch and Open at Login.
